title: Painting Contractor in Alachua County, FL
description: Painting contractor in Alachua County FL, based in Newberry. Our own crews paint homes and businesses from Gainesville historic districts to rural Archer.
h1: Painting Contractor in Alachua County, FL: Our Home County
heroIntro: Precision Paint Experts is based in Newberry, and Alachua County is where our crews spend the most days. We work in all seven of its towns, from Gainesville's historic districts to the farm roads around Archer and Hawthorne.

questions: Which towns in Alachua County do you paint in?
How do you paint older historic homes in Gainesville or Micanopy?
How soon can you start a project in Alachua County?

sections.h2: Based in Newberry, working the whole county
body: Our home base is Newberry, and Gainesville is one of the two largest markets we serve, so Alachua County is the center of our map. As a painting contractor in Alachua County FL, we cover everything from student-area rentals and postwar bungalows to ranches and brand-new subdivisions. Our own crews do all of it; we do not subcontract.
We are locally owned, licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member and more than 15 years of painting experience.

sections.h2: The seven Alachua County towns we serve
body: Gainesville: home of the University of Florida, with historic Duckpond and Pleasant Street, postwar bungalows in NW Gainesville, and newer homes in Haile Plantation and Town of Tioga. See our Gainesville painter page and Gainesville painting services.

Newberry: our hometown on Gainesville's western edge, with restored older homes near downtown and large new subdivisions heading toward Tioga. Visit painting in Newberry and the Newberry services list.
Alachua: historic Main Street, the Progress Park corridor, and large-lot homes on the north end of the county. See our Alachua city page and Alachua painting services.
High Springs: spring-fed rivers, a walkable downtown, and craftsman homes with original trim and clapboard. Read about High Springs painting and services in High Springs.
Archer: a small rural community west of Gainesville with farmhouses, ranches, and a few historic downtown commercial buildings. See Archer and Archer painting services.
Hawthorne: lakeside living near Lochloosa and Orange Lake, plus newer construction along SR-20. Visit Hawthorne and Hawthorne services.
Micanopy: Florida's oldest inland town, with antique shops, oak-canopied streets, and pre-war homes. See Micanopy and painting services in Micanopy.

sections.h2: Old wood and new builds: two very different jobs
body: Alachua County splits into two coating worlds. In the historic districts of Gainesville, Micanopy, and High Springs, the challenge is old wood carrying many layers of paint. Those homes need patient scraping to a sound edge, spot-priming of bare wood, and a respect for original trim and clapboard. Speed is the enemy there. Our guide to historic Gainesville paint colors covers the color side.

In the newer subdivisions around Newberry, Tioga, Haile Plantation, and SR-20, the problem is the opposite: builder-grade, single-coat finishes that start chalking after only a few years. Those houses need a thorough wash, any caulk failures fixed, and a real two-coat system of 100% acrylic or, on stucco with hairline cracks, elastomeric.
Lakeside homes near Lochloosa and Orange Lake add damp and mildew to the mix, and ranch and farm properties around Archer often bring wood siding and outbuildings with heavy sun exposure.

sections.h2: Work Alachua County clients ask for most
body: Requests here cover the full range. Interior repaints and cabinet refinishing are common in the established Gainesville neighborhoods. Exterior repaints and pressure washing are steady across every town. Commercial work for offices, retail, restaurants, churches, and multi-family buildings comes up often in Gainesville and Alachua, and HOA repaints follow the newer communities. Popcorn ceiling removal and drywall repair often join interior jobs in older homes.

Because so much of our work is here, walkthroughs are usually booked within 48 hours, and the written quote follows within one business day. Most projects begin one to three weeks after approval. Exteriors run best from October through May; in summer we work early and watch the radar.

faqs.q: Do you paint historic homes in Gainesville and Micanopy?
faqs.a: Yes. Older homes get careful scraping to a sound edge, spot-priming of bare wood, and coatings suited to aged substrates, all written into the estimate.

faqs.q: Where in Alachua County are you based?
faqs.a: We are based in Newberry, FL 32669. We do not publish a street address, but our crews work daily across the county.

faqs.q: Do you work with HOAs and property managers in Alachua County?
faqs.a: Yes. We paint for HOAs and property-management companies and provide a certificate of insurance naming your entity before mobilization.

faqs.q: Can you paint around a UF academic or rental calendar?
faqs.a: We can schedule commercial and multi-family work around operating hours, including nights and weekends, so tell us your dates during the walkthrough.
